_about: Owner-confirmed facts (data entry, never analysis). Written only by scripts/apply_upload.py from an upload manifest (data/uploads/*/manifest.json). players.<name>: team = club of record when the sheet says CUR/UNK or is out of date; team_history = earlier clubs; retired_with = the club on the game's Player HOF screen; status = Active/Retired when the sheet has no row; tag = the owner's own one-liner; card = player-card fields (team, former_team, legacy_team, note); career = what the owner said about the career path (order of clubs, on = [team, season] he was there, longest = the club he spent most seasons with, stints = exact [team, from, to], next_team = traded after the last season, says = the owner's words); real_nfl = real NFL games / rings / club before the save (imported players). active_rosters = the game's current team screens. season_rosters.<year> = who played for each club that season (games gained between screenshot sets).
